dodge.title: Dodge
dodge.text: Something's coming for you. Press {key:dodge} to roll out of the way - for a blink nothing can touch you, and a patch of ground marked for a blow is always worth leaving.

skill.title: {skill}
skill.text: {what} It's on your dock: press its number to use it. Energy comes back as you walk.

board.title: The notice board
board.text: Face it and press {key:interact}: fund the village's projects here, and Pixelheim grows the moment you step outside.

bounty.title: The bounty board
bounty.text: Named monsters, where they lair (marked on your map) and what they pay. Kill one and the bounty is yours on the spot.

turn.title: Turn sideways
turn.text: Pixelheim plays best in landscape: turn your phone sideways for bigger text and more room to fight.
